title: Pack / chest opening
one_line: The chest opens, items fly out in rarity order, the rarest last.

anatomy.spec: Centred chest render, tap-to-open (or auto-open after a beat).
Items fly out one at a time, common first, legendary last, each with its rarity glow and a brief hold before the next.
All items laid out as small cards (bible 5.17) with rarity ribbons once the reveal finishes.

states: Revealing (sequential, cannot be skipped past the legendary reveal)
Duplicate item - shows a coin-conversion value instead of a second copy
motion: Each item flies out and settles with a squash, rarest gets the biggest flourish (rays for legendary, per bible victory motion).
Legendary reveal cannot be tapped past - let the moment land (bible 2.9: never make two things compete for attention, and never rush the one big moment).
data: Pack contents come from the server/RevenueCat grant, not generated client-side, once shop purchases are real.
do_not: Do not let players skip the legendary reveal.
Do not generate pack contents on the client - the server decides rewards, same rule as the match itself.
Do not show a duplicate as if it were new inventory - convert it to coins and say so.
acceptance: Reveal order is always common to legendary.
Duplicates convert to coins with a clear line saying so.
steps: 2. Build the chest and sequential reveal.
3. Build the summary grid with rarity ribbons.
5. Wire contents to the server grant once available; use a mock list until then.
6. Capture unopened, mid-reveal and summary. Postflight.
prompt:

Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md, UI_BIBLE/LUDO_NX_UI_BIBLE.md sections 5.16, 5.17 and 2.9, and this whole file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json.

This does not exist yet. Build: a chest that opens on tap, items flying out one at a time in rarity order (common first, legendary last, each getting a bigger flourish - rays for the legendary), then a summary grid of small cards with rarity ribbons, and CONTINUE.

The legendary reveal cannot be tapped past - let the big moment land, per the bible's rule that nothing competes with the one earned celebration. A duplicate item converts to coins with a line saying so, rather than appearing as new inventory. Pack contents should come from a server/RevenueCat grant, not be generated on the client, once purchases are real.

Follow the 'steps' array. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list.
